unresolved: CHN (HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED): Multiple non-official reports (including China's State Council Information Office english.scio.gov.cn 2025-12-03, Xinhua, and industry alerts) state Cambodia granted a temporary trial visa exemption for PRC passport holders (reported to include Hong Kong and Macao SAR passports and to exclude Taiwan), 14 days per entry, multiple entries, no fee, from 2026-06-15 through 2026-10-15, announced via a Council of Ministers letter signed by standing secretary of state Hing Thoraxy and by the Ministry of Tourism (announcement reported 2026-01-16). This window COVERS the snapshot date 2026-07-23, meaning the CHN dispositions recorded here from official embassy pages (visa required) are likely superseded during the trial window. No reachable Cambodian government page confirmed it: mfaic.gov.kh is WAF-blocked, tourism.gov.kh and arrival.gov.kh render via JavaScript with no static content, and evisa.gov.kh is unreachable (redirect loop). Non-Cambodian sources were not used as evidence per source rules.

MFAIC visa-exemption list page unreachable: https://www.mfaic.gov.kh/Page/2025-03-26-Visa-Exemption-List-of-Visa-Exemption-between-Cambodia-and-other-Countries-15-22-56, https://www.mfaic.gov.kh/en/2025-03-26-visa-exemption-list-of-visa-exemption-between-cambodia-and-other-countries-15-22-56 and https://recberlin.mfaic.gov.kh/en-us/visa-exemption all returned WAF 'Request Rejected'. The exemption list was instead taken from the Royal Embassy of Cambodia in London FAQ, which may lag MFAIC updates.

Official eVisa portal https://www.evisa.gov.kh unreachable via fetcher: redirect loop (>10) on every path tried (/, /faq, /contact_us, /information/visa_type/4). Anti-bot protection was not bypassed. Consequently the eVisa government fee (widely reported USD 30 tourist since 2025-01-01, previously USD 36, possibly plus processing charge) is NOT recorded in fees, and the eVisa-accepted ports list and per-nationality eligibility restrictions are unverified.
Visa-on-arrival fee (widely reported USD 30 tourist / USD 35 business) and VOA per-nationality eligibility are not stated on any fetched official page; no VOA fee recorded.
Blank-page rule differs between official embassy pages: Washington DC requires at least 1 blank visa page; London and Canberra require at least 2 blank pages.
